remarks: Welcome to this completely renovated three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bathroom home in Norwalk, CT. This residence offers modern living in a move-in-ready condition from top to bottom. The main level features an open-concept layout connecting the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The kitchen is equipped with new stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and contemporary cabinetry. A convenient half-bathroom is also located on this floor. Upstairs, you will find three bedrooms, including a primary suite with a private, fully renovated bathroom. A second renovated full bathroom serves the additional bedrooms. The home includes newer systems, such as HVAC, plumbing, and electrical, for contemporary efficiency. Provides access to local parks, schools, shopping, and commuter routes, including Metro-North train stations for service to New York City.This is a turnkey property designed for comfortable, low-maintenance living.
